groups.description: Group definitions to create. Each dictionary should use canonical Sisense group fields, at minimum ``name``.

group_id.description: The ID of the group to delete.

description: Retrieve groups — one named group, or all of them.

name.description: Group name to filter by. Omit for all groups.

description: Retrieve group memberships — one group's members, or every membership.

group_name.description: The name of the group whose members to list. Omit for all memberships. A name that matches no group returns ``{"error": "..."}`` naming it — never a silent empty list. Naming ``Everyone`` or ``All users in system`` returns their members — an explicit request is always honored, even though the all-groups view omits them.

examples.notes: This call retrieves all users belonging to the 'Data Analysts' group. Use it to audit group membership or fetch user details for further processing.
